description: The Marine Corps Software Factory (MCSWF) has a continued requirement for consulting and training service credits/vouchers to educate, mentor, and maintain software development skills for their service members.  The training credits that will be acquired will be used to provide accelerated one-to-one training for Marines to become Software Developers, UI/UX Designers, Product Manager, and Platform Engineers. The training vouchers have a validity period of 365 days from the commencement of the award. The anticipated NAICS Code is 611430 – Professional and Management Development Training.
